data.name: Pet
data.gender_notes: Pet is used as a unisex name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Pet is recorded in name-lists as “Rock, Stone”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Pet expresses “Rock, Stone”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Pet total 14, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: פת
in_hebrew.long_meaning: a short form of the name Mattityahu, meaning 'gift of God' or 'gift of Yahweh', derived from the Hebrew word פתח (petach), meaning 'bread'

in_greek.name: Πέτρος
in_greek.long_meaning: a transliteration of the Hebrew name Petach or Petah, meaning 'rock' in Greek, as in the name of the disciple Peter

in_latin.name: Petrus
in_latin.long_meaning: a Latinized form of the Greek name Petros, meaning 'rock'
